feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 26 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 26 November 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry for much of the day, then rain will arrive in the evening. The southeast winds will increase, becoming fresh to strong by about lunchtime, then possibly touch gale force around the northern and southern tips of the island by the end of the day. Maximum temperature 8°C.

Comments: Strong winds. Risk of gales in exposed areas later. Snowdonia providing some shelter, limiting the extent of gale force winds.

Rain at first tomorrow, heavy at times, but clearing during the morning, leaving the rest of the day generally dry with sunny/ clear intervals. The strong to gale force southeast winds will ease as the rain clears. Max temperature 9°C.

Comments: Strong to gale force winds and heavy rain at first. Risk of coastal overtopping (at ~00:35 hours). Heavy rain at first, risk of localised flooding.


##Outlook##

Cloudy but dry at first on Saturday but then rain developing at times. Moderate or fresh southeast winds, veering to the west later in the day. Top temperature 10°C.

Comments: Strong winds in places for a time.

8:07am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

4:04pm Tomorrow
